attractions.name: Amber Fort & Palace
attractions.description: Hilltop fort with ornate courtyards, cobblestone paths, and the mesmerizing Sheesh Mahal.

attractions.name: City Palace & Museum
attractions.description: A stunning blend of Rajasthani and Mughal architecture with preserved royal courtyards and weaponry galleries.

attractions.name: Jantar Mantar
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage collection of nineteen architectural astronomical instruments built by Maharaja Jai Singh II.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal & Bapu Bazaar
attractions.description: High honeycomb screen wall of pink sandstone built for royal women; explore nearby colorful bazaar lanes.

attractions.name: Nahargarh Fort Sunset Viewpoint
attractions.description: Stunning ridge overlooking the entire Pink City skyline during golden hour.

dining.name: Laxmi Misthan Bhandar (LMB)
dining.description: Legendary sweetshop and restaurant inside old walled city serving Ghewar and Dal Baati Churma.

dining.name: 1135 AD Amber
dining.description: Fine-dining inside Amber Fort ramparts with antique chandeliers and silver cutlery.

dining.name: Rawat Mishthan Bhandar
dining.description: Famous station-side stop for piping-hot onion kachoris and rich creamy lassi.

transport.description: Great for navigating narrow bazaar lanes; bargain or use pre-paid stands.
transport.tip: Agree on fare beforehand or use meter/app.

transport.description: Air-conditioned travel for longer distances like Amber Fort and Nahargarh.
transport.tip: Book return cab early from Nahargarh hilltop.

transport.description: Fast air-conditioned link from Railway Station to Chandpole (walled city).
transport.tip: Very economical for solo and budget travelers.

attractions.name: Upper Lake (Bhojtal) & Boat Club
attractions.description: One of India's oldest man-made lakes, ideal for motor boating, paddle boating, and tranquil promenade walks.

attractions.name: Van Vihar National Park
attractions.description: Open zoological park on lake shores; rent a bicycle and spot tigers, deer, and migratory birds in natural habitats.

attractions.name: Tribal Museum Bhopal
attractions.description: Acclaimed experiential museum showcasing life-sized indigenous art, rituals, and architecture of MP tribes.

attractions.name: Taj-ul-Masajid
attractions.description: One of Asia's largest mosques featuring towering pink minarets, massive domes, and a grand marble courtyard.

attractions.name: Sanchi Stupa Excursion
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage 3rd-century BCE Buddhist complex founded by Emperor Ashoka with intricate stone toranas.

dining.name: Chatori Gali (Old Bhopal)
dining.signature_dish: Bhopali Gosht Korma, Poha Jalebi & Sulaimani Chai
dining.description: Vibrant food street inside the heritage quarter famous for melt-in-mouth delicacies and spiced tea.

dining.name: Under The Mango Tree (Jehan Numa Palace)
dining.description: Open-air courtyard dining under an ancient mango tree in a heritage palace property.

dining.name: Manohar Dairy & Restaurant
dining.description: Bhopal's most beloved multi-generation vegetarian institution for breakfast, lunch, and fresh mithai.

transport.description: The quintessential Bhopal way to travel between Old City and New Market.
transport.tip: Share-autos run fixed routes between New Market and Old City for ₹15-20.

transport.description: Air-conditioned red buses connecting major junctions and universities.

transport.tip: Carry photo ID at the park gate for bicycle issuance.

attractions.name: Palolem & Agonda Beach
attractions.description: Crescent-shaped golden sand beach with calm waters, coconut palms, and peaceful shacks in South Goa.

attractions.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls Trek
attractions.description: Four-tiered majestic white-water cascade situated inside Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary.

attractions.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Walking Tour
attractions.description: UNESCO-recognized vibrant Portuguese-style colonial quarter with pastel yellow houses and artisan cafes.

attractions.name: Anjuna Beach & Flea Market
attractions.description: Iconic North Goa bohemian hotspot for seaside music, handicrafts, and twilight sunsets.

dining.name: Fisherman's Wharf
dining.description: Lakeside dining showcasing authentic Goan coconut gravies and freshly caught seafood.

dining.name: Gunpowder (Assagao)
dining.signature_dish: Kerala Appam with Stew & Pandi Curry
dining.description: Sensational heritage courtyard restaurant serving fiery South Indian coastal recipes.

dining.name: Vinayak Family Restaurant
dining.signature_dish: Special Goan Fish / Veg Thali with Sol Kadhi
dining.description: Unpretentious local favorite overlooking paddy fields with affordable authentic seafood thalis.

transport.description: The quintessential Goa transport mode; helmet strictly required.
transport.tip: Fuel is available at local bottle stalls or petrol pumps; inspect vehicle brakes beforehand.

transport.description: Government-regulated app-based taxi service across North and South Goa.
transport.tip: Pre-booking from Dabolim or MOPA airport is recommended.

transport.description: Connects Panaji, Margao, Mapusa, and Vasco quickly and cheaply.
transport.tip: Departs every 15 minutes from main bus terminals.

attractions.name: Rajwada Palace
attractions.description: Historic seven-story palace of the Holkar dynasty blending Maratha, Mughal, and French styles.

attractions.name: Sarafa Bazaar Night Food Street
attractions.description: A jewelry market by day that turns into India's most celebrated street food haven by night.

attractions.name: Chappan Dukan (56 Shops)
attractions.description: A bustling culinary strip of exactly 56 gourmet and traditional street food kiosks, including Johnny Hot Dog.

attractions.name: Lal Bagh Palace
attractions.description: Magnificent European-style palace featuring Versailles-inspired gates, Italian marble, and Persian rugs.

dining.name: Sarafa Bazaar Specialty Stalls
dining.signature_dish: Bhutte ka Kees, Garadu, Joshi Dahi Bada & Jaleba
dining.description: Legendary flying dahi badas and grated corn delicacies served fresh under starry skies.

dining.name: Apna Sweets (Chappan)
dining.signature_dish: Indori Poha with Sev, Usal Poha & Gulab Jamun
dining.description: Clean, award-winning breakfast stop for Indori poha with jeeravan masala.

transport.description: Dedicated corridor buses traversing the central spine of Indore.
The easiest way to get between Rajwada, Sarafa, and railway station.
transport.tip: Fixed fare or digital payment widely accepted.

attractions.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat Evening Ganga Aarti
attractions.description: Grand synchronized prayer ritual with brass lamps, incense, conch shells, and floating flower diyas.

attractions.name: Sunrise Boat Ride on River Ganga
attractions.description: Rowing past historic ghats from Assi Ghat to Manikarnika Ghat as the morning sun casts gold on the river.

attractions.name: Kashi Vishwanath Corridor & Temple
attractions.description: Golden spire Jyotirlinga temple connected to Ganga ghats through a renovated majestic stone corridor.

attractions.name: Sarnath Deer Park & Dhamek Stupa
attractions.description: Where Lord Buddha preached his first sermon; site of the Ashoka Pillar with India's national emblem.

dining.name: Kashi Chat Bhandar
dining.signature_dish: Tamatar Chaat, Palak Chaat & Gulab Jamun
dining.description: World-famous street food spot serving piping-hot Banarasi tomato chaat in clay kulhads.

dining.name: Blue Lassi Shop
dining.description: Legendary alleyway hole-in-the-wall serving thick hand-churned lassi in earthen pots with rabdi toppings.

transport.description: Cars cannot enter old ghat alleys; cycle rickshaws and walking are the best way to explore.
Traditional method of traversing across the ghats and crossing to sandy eastern bank.
transport.tip: Negotiate fixed rate before boarding at Assi or Dashashwamedh Ghat.
